categories.name: Robot
categories.description: En maskine, der sanser og påvirker sine omgivelser ved at bevæge sig, håndtere genstande eller interagere med mennesker. Robotter klassificeres efter fysisk form, ikke efter brugergruppe eller anvendelse.
categories.inclusion_rule: Sold as a complete, programmable robot (consistent with ISO 8373:2021). Parts sold separately are components (cp).

categories.name: Robotarm
categories.description: Manipulator på fast base, der placerer en endeeffektor i rummet.
categories.inclusion_rule: Fixed base (floor, table, wall, ceiling, a separately sold mobile base, or a cart or stand that people move between jobs); manipulates, meaning it positions a tool, gripper or sensor head in space; not humanoid in form.

categories.name: Leddelt robotarm
categories.description: Seriel arm med tre eller flere roterende led, herunder 6- og 7-aksede industriarme, cobots og bordarme.
categories.inclusion_rule: At least three rotary joints in series. Collaborative safety features do not change the category (attribute collaborative). An arm with more bending segments than independently driven joints, bending along its length, is a continuum arm (rb-1-6), even if each segment is a rotary joint. An arm whose every joint has its own drive, even through cables from the base, stays here.

categories.name: SCARA-arm
categories.description: Arm med to parallelle, lodrette roterende led og en lodret lineær akse, eftergivende i det vandrette plan.
categories.inclusion_rule: Two parallel vertical rotary joints plus a vertical prismatic axis.

categories.name: Parallelarm
categories.description: Manipulator med parallel kinematik, fx en deltarobot, en hexapod-/Stewart-platform eller en kabeldrevet parallelrobot.
categories.inclusion_rule: End-effector carried by two or more kinematic chains acting in parallel. The chains may be rigid links or cables pulled by winches (cable-driven parallel robots).

categories.name: Kartesisk arm
categories.description: Manipulator med tre lineære akser langs et kartesisk koordinatsystem, herunder portal- og lineærrobotter.
categories.inclusion_rule: Three prismatic (linear) main axes.

categories.name: Cylindrisk og sfærisk arm
categories.full_name: Robot > Robotarm > Cylindrisk og sfærisk arm
categories.description: Manipulator med roterende base og en lineær udstrækningsakse: cylindrisk (lineært løft) eller sfærisk/polær (vippende skulder). IFR-typeklasse 30.
categories.inclusion_rule: Rotary base combined with a prismatic reach axis; the second axis is either a prismatic lift (cylindrical) or a rotary tilt (spherical / polar).

categories.name: Kontinuumsarm
categories.description: Arm, der bøjer sig i hele sin længde – med en sammenhængende fleksibel rygrad eller mange korte segmenter, der drives fra basen – fx slangearmsrobotter og robotkatetre.
categories.inclusion_rule: Bends along its length rather than at a few independently driven joints — a continuous backbone, or a chain of segments bent together by tendons, cables, pull wires, concentric tubes or fluid pressure, so that it has more bending segments than independently driven joints. Takes precedence over articulated even when the segments are rotary joints; an arm whose every joint has its own drive, even through cables from the base, is articulated. When a positioning arm and a continuum instrument are sold as one system, the continuum instrument decides (robotic catheters); short cable-driven instrument wrists do not (multiport surgical robots stay articulated). Included even if it only carries a camera or sensor head, and when the body grows from its tip (vine robot). Snake robots that move themselves along the ground are not arms (design notes §2.1, unplaced).

categories.name: Humanoid
categories.description: Robot, der er designet til at ligne et menneske, med torso, to arme og et hoved eller ansigt, beregnet til menneskers omgivelser.
categories.inclusion_rule: Designed to look human, with a torso, two arms and a head or face (a screen face counts). Legs that end in wheels are still legs. Locomotion decides the child category.

categories.name: Tobenet humanoid
categories.description: Humanoid, der går på to ben.
categories.inclusion_rule: Humanoid form with two articulated legs used for locomotion.

categories.name: Humanoid på hjulbase
categories.description: Humanoid overkrop på en base med hjul eller bælter.
categories.inclusion_rule: Humanoid upper body (designed to look human, with a torso, two arms and a head or face) on a wheeled or tracked base that it drives itself on, instead of legs (a torso on casters that people push is fixed-base, rb-2-3). A two-armed robot on a wheeled base that is not designed to look human is a mobile manipulator (rb-5).

categories.name: Humanoid på fast base
categories.full_name: Robot > Humanoid > Humanoid på fast base
categories.description: Humanoid overkrop på et fast fundament, uden fremdrift.
categories.inclusion_rule: Humanoid torso, arms and head with no locomotion system.

categories.name: Robot med ben
categories.description: Robot, der bevæger sig på leddelte ben og ikke er humanoid af form.
categories.inclusion_rule: Articulated legs; wheels on the feet or an add-on arm do not change the category.

categories.name: Firbenet robot
categories.full_name: Robot > Robot med ben > Firbenet robot
categories.description: Robot med fire ben.
categories.inclusion_rule: Four articulated legs. Wheel-feet (attribute wheel_feet) and add-on arms (attribute has_arm) stay in this category.

categories.name: Tobenet robot
categories.full_name: Robot > Robot med ben > Tobenet robot
categories.description: Robot med to ben, uden humanoid torso, arme og hoved.
categories.inclusion_rule: Two articulated legs; fails the humanoid test (not designed to look human with a torso, two arms and a head or face).

categories.name: Flerbenet robot
categories.full_name: Robot > Robot med ben > Flerbenet robot
categories.description: Robot med seks eller flere ben.
categories.inclusion_rule: Six or more articulated legs.

categories.name: Kørende robot
categories.description: Robot, der kører på hjul eller bælter, uden ben og uden integreret arm.
categories.inclusion_rule: Moves itself on wheels or tracks; no legs; no arm sold as part of the product (an add-on arm is attribute has_arm). Wheels or tracks count only when the robot moves itself on them as part of its task, including between work stations; wheels or casters on which people move it between jobs (a surgical patient cart, a cobot on a trolley), even with power assist, do not count, and nor do passive wheels on a robot that moves by bending its body. Wheeled or tracked crawlers, including snake-shaped ones on driven tracks, are ground robots; inchworm and peristaltic pipe robots are not (unplaced).

categories.name: Robot på hjul
categories.full_name: Robot > Kørende robot > Robot på hjul
categories.description: Kørende robot drevet af hjul.
categories.inclusion_rule: Locomotion by wheels. Vacuum, mowing, delivery, telepresence and similar are applications, not categories.

categories.name: Bælterobot
categories.description: Kørende robot drevet af bælter.
categories.inclusion_rule: Locomotion by continuous tracks.

categories.name: Mobil manipulator
categories.description: Base med hjul eller bælter og en eller flere arme, solgt som ét produkt, ikke humanoid af form.
categories.inclusion_rule: Base that moves itself on wheels or tracks (including between work stations, then parks while the arm works) and arm(s), sold together as one product. A base and an arm sold separately are two entries linked by compatible_with. An arm on casters or a cart that people move between jobs, even with power assist (a surgical patient cart, a cobot on a trolley), is an arm (rb-1).

categories.name: Flyvende robot
categories.description: Robot, der flyver.
categories.inclusion_rule: Primary operating medium is air.

categories.name: Multirotor
categories.description: Flyvende robot, der løftes af flere rotorer.
categories.inclusion_rule: Lift from one or more rotors; no fixed wing. Single-rotor helicopters are included.

categories.name: Fastvinget
categories.description: Flyvende robot, der løftes af en fast vinge.
categories.inclusion_rule: Lift from a fixed wing; cannot hover.

categories.name: Hybrid VTOL
categories.description: Flyvende robot, der kombinerer lodret start med rotorer og flyvning på fast vinge.
categories.inclusion_rule: Both rotors for vertical flight and a fixed wing for cruise.

categories.name: Vandrobot
categories.description: Robot, der arbejder på eller i vand.
categories.inclusion_rule: Primary operating medium is water. Amphibious products go to the medium they are marketed for.

categories.name: ROV
categories.description: Undervandsfartøj, der er forbundet med overfladen via et kabel, uanset om det fjernstyres eller kører autonomt.
categories.inclusion_rule: Submersible; tethered. The tether decides, even if it carries only power and the vehicle runs its mission on its own (corded pool cleaners).

categories.name: AUV
categories.description: Autonomt undervandsfartøj uden kabel.
categories.inclusion_rule: Submersible; untethered. Includes cordless pool cleaners that crawl the floor.

categories.name: USV
categories.description: Ubemandet overfladefartøj.
categories.inclusion_rule: Operates on the water surface.

categories.name: Kropsbåren robot
categories.description: Robot, der bæres på kroppen.
categories.inclusion_rule: Worn on the body and powered. Passive (unpowered) exoskeletons are out of scope for this taxonomy.

categories.name: Exoskelet
categories.description: Motordrevet exoskelet eller exosuit, der støtter eller forstærker menneskets bevægelser.
categories.inclusion_rule: Powered actuation applied alongside one or more intact body regions. Rigid exoskeletons and soft, textile exosuits are both included (attribute construction).

categories.name: Protese
categories.description: Motoriseret eller mikroprocessorstyret protese til et lem eller led, der erstatter en manglende kropsdel.
categories.inclusion_rule: Replaces, rather than assists, a limb or joint, and is motor-driven or microprocessor-controlled (e.g. a knee that adjusts its own damping). Purely mechanical prostheses are out of scope.

categories.name: Stationær robot
categories.description: Robot på fast base, ikke humanoid, som ikke håndterer genstande, fx en skrivebordsrobot eller social robot uden arme.
categories.inclusion_rule: Fixed base; no locomotion; no manipulator; not humanoid in form (a humanoid torso on a stand is rb-2-3). Last rule in the tie-break order.

categories.name: Byggesæt
categories.description: Modulært byggesæt uden fast kropsform, som bliver til en programmerbar robot.
categories.inclusion_rule: Sold as parts to be assembled into user-chosen forms; the result is programmable. Generic electronics kits are excluded.

categories.name: Komponent
categories.description: En robotdel eller et tilbehør, der sælges separat fra en komplet robot.
categories.inclusion_rule: Sold separately and intended to be fitted to, or used with, a robot.

categories.name: Endeeffektor
categories.description: Enhed monteret for enden af en robotarm eller et håndled, som påvirker omgivelserne.
categories.inclusion_rule: Mounts to a robot wrist or tool flange and performs grasping or a process.

categories.name: Griber
categories.description: Gribende endeeffektor, som ikke er en menneskelignende hånd.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps objects; fewer than four fingers, no opposable thumb, or fewer than six DOF. Child category is decided by gripping principle, not actuation.

categories.name: Fingergriber
categories.description: Griber med mekaniske fingre eller kæber, herunder parallel- og vinkelgribere og adaptive gribere med 2–3 fingre.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps by closing rigid or semi-rigid fingers or jaws on the object.

categories.name: Vakuumgriber
categories.description: Griber, der holder med sug, herunder sugekopper, skumgribere og fladegribere.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps by vacuum or suction, including Bernoulli and other non-contact suction grippers.

categories.name: Magnetgriber
categories.description: Griber, der holder jernholdige emner med magnetkraft.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps by permanent or electro-magnetic force.

categories.name: Blød griber
categories.description: Griber med eftergivende eller oppustelige fingre.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasping surfaces are compliant elastomer, inflatable or granular-jamming structures.

categories.name: Robothånd
categories.description: Menneskelignende endeeffektor med fire eller flere fingre, herunder en modstillelig tommelfinger, og flere frihedsgrader.
categories.inclusion_rule: At least four fingers including an opposable thumb and at least six actuated degrees of freedom (joints driven independently, not passive or coupled joints).

categories.name: Værktøj
categories.description: Procesværktøj som en svejsebrænder, spindel, skruetrækker eller doseringsenhed. Et kamera monteret på håndleddet er en sensor (cp-3-1), ikke et værktøj.
categories.inclusion_rule: Performs a process rather than grasping. A tool with a secondary gripping function is classified by its primary marketed purpose.

categories.name: Værktøjsskifter
categories.description: Hurtigkobling mellem robottens håndled og udskiftelige endeeffektorer.
categories.inclusion_rule: Couples and decouples end-effectors; does not itself grasp or process.

categories.name: Aktuator
categories.description: Enhed, der skaber bevægelse i et robotled eller en akse.
categories.inclusion_rule: Produces rotary or linear motion; sold as a unit, not integrated into a robot.

categories.name: Ledmodul
categories.description: Integreret roterende aktuator, der samler motor, gear, encoder og driver i én enhed.
categories.inclusion_rule: Integrated reducer and controller, sold as a joint for robots (robot-grade packaging, torque rating and bus — EtherCAT, CAN or high-speed RS-485). The bus alone does not decide; the grade and purpose do.

categories.name: Servo
categories.description: Hobby- eller smart-servo med indbygget styring og en seriel bus (daisy-chain).
categories.inclusion_rule: Packaged hobby-grade servo with built-in control, on a daisy-chain serial bus (TTL, RS-485) or PWM; sold for hobby, education and desktop robots rather than as a robot joint.

categories.name: Motor
categories.description: Ren elmotor, fx BLDC, stepmotor eller rammeløs motor, uden gear eller integreret styring.
categories.inclusion_rule: Motor sold without an integrated servo controller. A motor with a gearhead but no driver (gearmotor) is a motor, not a reducer.

categories.name: Reduktionsgear
categories.description: Gearenhed som harmonisk/strain-wave, cykloide/RV eller planetgear.
categories.inclusion_rule: Reduces speed and multiplies torque; sold without a motor.

categories.name: Lineær aktuator
categories.description: Aktuator, der skaber retlinet bevægelse, fx planetrulleskrue, kugleskrue, pneumatisk eller hydraulisk cylinder.
categories.inclusion_rule: Output motion is linear.

categories.name: Sensor
categories.description: Enhed, der måler robotten selv eller dens omgivelser.
categories.inclusion_rule: Primary function is sensing. A camera with onboard AI is still a sensor; a device with several sensing modalities is classified by its primary output. A sensing device sold to drive or teach a robot (a glove, a leader arm) is teleoperation (cp-7).

categories.name: Kamera
categories.description: Billedsensor, herunder RGB-, dybde-, stereo-, termiske og eventkameraer.
categories.inclusion_rule: Produces images or depth maps.

categories.name: Lidar
categories.description: Laserbaseret afstandssensor, 2D eller 3D.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures range by laser time-of-flight or phase.

categories.name: Kraft-/momentsensor
categories.description: Sensor, der måler kraft og moment ved et håndled eller led, typisk i 3 eller 6 akser.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures force and/or torque along defined axes.

categories.name: Taktil sensor
categories.description: Sensor, der måler berøring, tryk eller tekstur på en overflade.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures distributed contact over a surface, including capacitive skins that sense approach before contact.

categories.name: Inertisensor / encoder
categories.description: Bevægelses- og positionssensorer som IMU'er og encodere.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures acceleration, angular rate, orientation or shaft position.

categories.name: Afstands-/positionssensor
categories.description: Ikke-laserbaserede afstands- og absolutte positionssensorer som GNSS-modtagere, radar og ultralyds- eller ToF-afstandsmålere.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures distance or absolute position without a laser scanner or an imaging array.

categories.name: Computer
categories.description: Robotcontrollere, enkeltkortcomputere og edge-AI-moduler.
categories.inclusion_rule: Processing hardware without sensing.

categories.name: Strøm
categories.description: Batteripakker, opladere og ladestationer.
categories.inclusion_rule: Stores or supplies electrical energy to a robot. A docking station is power, not structure.

categories.name: Struktur
categories.description: Rammer, beslag, kabinetter, flanger og kabelføring.
categories.inclusion_rule: Mechanical parts with no actuation, sensing or compute.

categories.name: Fjernstyring
categories.description: Udstyr til at styre en robot på afstand eller indsamle demonstrationsdata, fx leader-arme, haptiske enheder og VR- eller motion capture-udstyr.
categories.inclusion_rule: Operated by a human to drive or teach a robot. This wins over the sensor branch for gloves and rigs full of sensors.
